buildOnlyTools.isolatedSdkAdjustment: The selected Apple CLT lacked its default libc++ include directory. An isolated clang++ wrapper selected the matching SDK usr/include/c++/v1 via -isystem; no global tool installation or product runtime dependency was added.

abi.method: Node process.report sharedObjects resolved to the isolated candidate file, whose hash matched the staged dylib. The original Sharp addon hash was unchanged.
abi.signature: Ad-hoc codesign --verify --strict passed; this is not Developer ID signing or notarization

notExercised: Complete desktop package with this replacement library

privacy.scope: Exact local build prefix, home-directory prefixes and known local account value; all archived regular-file contents and ownership/timestamp/link metadata were checked. Original third-party author attribution remains intact.

heifHeaderRegeneration.mechanism: Official CMake configure_file from exact upstream heif_version.h.in; PLUGIN_DIRECTORY supplied via supported option in full build recipe.

reproduction.method: Full pinned POSIX recipe built the candidate. GLib/Pango/libvips were then clean-rebuilt with the published default-directory patches and relinked. The disabled libheif plugin header default was regenerated with upstream CMake configure_file; its only consumer preprocessed identically before/after, so library bytes were unchanged.

remainingReleaseRequirements: Publish and exercise a complete clean rebuild entry point with toolchain inputs, every patch, library-replacement instructions and the corresponding-source artifact. A source URL catalog is not source delivery.
Complete legal review and include all applicable original license/copyright texts for the custom native artifact. Removing librsvg does not make libvips or libheif MIT-licensed.
Qualify the exact replacement in a full managed desktop package, including launch, cancellation, privacy, signing and supported target platforms.
Give the custom artifact an explicit provenance/integrity identity before any runtime dependency change. Keep the existing managed-runtime release gate disabled until acceptance is complete.
legacyAudit: DISTRIBUTION.json remains the audit of the locked official npm binaries. Its macOS librsvg notice gaps are not waived by this separate candidate.
